The '''Ison system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing the [[Ison/Legends|Ison]] debris field. It was located at the end of the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], on the opposite end to the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]]. The only sizable body in the system was the [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Ison (star)|star]] at its center.
